lines.say: BCAAs. Are they worth your money?
BCAAs are three of the nine essential amino acids: leucine, isoleucine and valine.
Leucine flips the switch for muscle building.
But to actually build muscle, you need all nine.
Taking just three is like getting bricks but no cement.
Reviews found BCAAs add little if you already eat enough protein.
Protein foods and whey already contain plenty of BCAAs.
So spend the money on food first.
